# Nexub Design System

> Token-driven React design system for SaaS products: @nexub/react components, @nexub/patterns composites, @nexub/tokens, @nexub/themes, @nexub/icons. Calm Depth visual language with an optional Liquid Glass material layer.

Version 9.9.0. Install: `npm install @nexub/react @nexub/patterns @nexub/themes @nexub/tokens @nexub/icons`. Full reference for LLMs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/llms-full.txt

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/getting-started): install, Tailwind preset, ThemeProvider
- [Principles](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/foundations/principles): the six Calm Depth rules
- [Colors](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/foundations/colors): color roles and contrast
- [Materials](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/foundations/materials): Liquid Glass rules
- [Theme builder](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/foundations/theme-builder): one brand colour to a contrast-checked theme
- [AI tools and MCP](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/getting-started/ai-tools): connect @nexub/mcp, the Claude Code plugin and these files to your AI tool

## Components

- [Accordion](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/accordion.md): Vertically stacked list of collapsible sections.
- [Action Bar](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/action-bar.md): Save and cancel that stay in view at the bottom of a long form.
- [Alert Dialog](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/alert-dialog.md): Confirmation dialog that requires an explicit user action before proceeding.
- [Alert](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/alert.md): Inline contextual message with optional title, icon, and dismiss action.
- [Amount](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/amount.md): Honest money: Intl formatting, tabular numerals, the currency’s minor unit and a true minus sign.
- [App Shell](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/app-shell.md): Full-height application frame: a header row over a body with a sidebar slot and a scrolling main region.
- [Approval Card](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/approval-card.md): The agent asks before it acts: what will happen, then Approve or Deny.
- [Aspect Ratio](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/aspect-ratio.md): Keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio, for images, video and embeds.
- [Aurora](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/aurora.md): A decorative background of slow-drifting colour fields from the accent roles. Subtle by default, richer under data-expression="vivid".
- [Autocomplete](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/autocomplete.md): Type-to-search input with matching options dropdown.
- [Avatar Group](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/avatar-group.md): Stacked group of avatars with overflow count.
- [Avatar](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/avatar.md): Displays a user's profile picture with initials fallback.
- [Badge](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/badge.md): Small status indicator or label. Communicates state, category, or count.
- [Bar Chart](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/bar-chart.md): Compare values across categories, grouped or stacked. Server-rendered SVG on the chart palette.
- [Box](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/box.md): Generic container primitive with style token props.
- [Breadcrumb](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/breadcrumb.md): Hierarchical navigation trail showing page location.
- [Button Group](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/button-group.md): Groups related buttons together with optional attachment and orientation.
- [Button](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/button.md): Triggers an action or event. Supports multiple variants, sizes, and semantic tones.
- [Card](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/card.md): Surface container for grouping related content. Supports flat, surface, and interactive variants.
- [Celebrate](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/celebrate.md): A short confetti burst for a real win, such as a first payment or finishing onboarding.
- [Chart Toggle](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/chart-toggle.md): A legend whose entries switch series on and off, wrapped around any chart.
- [Chart Zoom](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/chart-zoom.md): Zoom any chart to part of its range with a two-thumb slider.
- [Check List](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/check-list.md): A list with a success tick before each item, for features, plan inclusions and requirements met.
- [Checkbox Card](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/checkbox-card.md): A checkbox drawn as a whole card: title, description and optional icon. Pick any number.
- [Checkbox](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/checkbox.md): Binary checkbox input built on Radix UI.
- [Chip](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/chip.md): Compact label chip, optionally dismissible.
- [Citation](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/citation.md): Numbered source markers for running text, with a hover preview, plus SourceChip and SourceList for the sources under a reply.
- [Code](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/code-inline.md): Inline code span for technical terms and short code snippets.
- [Collapsible](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/collapsible.md): Toggle visibility of content with smooth animation.
- [Combobox](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/combobox.md): Command-palette style searchable dropdown built on cmdk.
- [Command Palette](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/command-palette.md): A searchable command menu in a modal dialog (cmdk), with nested pages, recents and an optional Cmd+K shortcut.
- [Container](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/container.md): Centres content at a maximum width with responsive side padding.
- [Context Menu](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/context-menu.md): A menu that opens at the pointer on right-click (or long-press), built on Radix.
- [Country Badge](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/country-badge.md): A pill with a country flag and its name or code.
- [Data Table](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/data-table.md): Feature-rich data table with sorting and row selection powered by TanStack Table.
- [Date Picker](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/date-picker.md): Calendar date picker with text input.
- [Date Range Picker](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/date-range-picker.md): Dual-calendar date range selector.
- [Date Time Picker](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/date-time-picker.md): A DatePicker and a TimePicker that edit one Date, with an optional time-zone label.
- [Dialog](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/dialog.md): Modal dialog built on Radix UI. Fully accessible with focus trapping and ARIA roles.
- [Diff View](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/diff-view.md): A unified diff with added and removed lines, for agent changes.
- [Donut Chart](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/donut-chart.md): Parts of a whole, with an optional total in the hole. Keep it to six slices or fewer.
- [Drawer](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/drawer.md): Slide-in panel from any edge of the screen.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/dropdown-menu.md): A menu of actions opened from a button, built on Radix.
- [Empty State](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/empty-state.md): Placeholder UI shown when a list or page has no content.
- [Error State](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/error-state.md): Full-page or section error view with retry action.
- [Event Calendar](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/event-calendar.md): A month or week grid of events. Display only: your app owns the events and what a click does.
- [Eyebrow Chip](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/eyebrow-chip.md): A compact eyebrow label, typically used above headings.
- [Fieldset](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/fieldset.md): Groups related fields under a legend; disabling it disables everything inside.
- [File Upload](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/file-upload.md): A drop zone and file list: pick, drop or paste files, with type, size and count checks and per-file progress.
- [Filter Builder](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/filter-builder.md): Build AND/OR filter queries with nested groups. The output is plain JSON your app runs.
- [Filter Chip](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/filter-chip.md): Interactive chip for filtering, supports selected/unselected state.
- [Flag](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/flag.md): A country flag from its ISO code, drawn with the system emoji font.
- [Flex](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/flex.md): Flexbox layout primitive.
- [Floating Input](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/floating-input.md): A text field whose label sits inside and floats up on focus or input. CSS only.
- [Form Error](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/form-error.md): An error message with an alert icon, announced when it appears.
- [Form Field](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/form-field.md): Wraps Label, Input, HelperText and FormError into a single accessible group.
- [Form](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/form.md): Validates on submit with the browser’s own checks plus yours, shows each message on its FormField and focuses the first invalid field.
- [Funnel](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/funnel.md): Drop-off through ordered steps, with conversion from the first step.
- [Gauge](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/gauge.md): Progress toward a target on a 270° arc.
- [Gradient Divider](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/gradient-divider.md): A decorative gradient-faded horizontal rule.
- [Grid](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/grid.md): CSS Grid layout primitive.
- [Heading](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/heading.md): Semantic heading component with size, weight, and tone control.
- [Heatmap](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/heatmap.md): Intensity over a grid, such as activity by weekday and week, in seven sequential steps.
- [Helper Text](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/helper-text.md): Small supporting text placed beneath a form field to provide hints or validation feedback.
- [Hover Card](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/hover-card.md): Rich tooltip card revealed on hover.
- [Icon Button](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/icon-button.md): A square button designed to hold a single icon, with an accessible label.
- [Inline Edit](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/inline-edit.md): Text that becomes an input on click, for renaming things in place.
- [Input](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/input.md): Text input field for forms. Supports size variants, icons, addons, and validation states.
- [Kanban](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/kanban.md): Columns of cards people move by dragging or with Alt+Arrow keys.
- [Kbd](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/kbd.md): Keyboard key display — renders a styled <kbd> element.
- [Keyboard Shortcut](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/keyboard-shortcut.md): A key combination as `Kbd` keys joined by plus signs, read as one label.
- [KPI Tile](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/kpi-tile.md): A headline number with its change versus last period and a trend line.
- [Label](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/label.md): An accessible form label that optionally shows a required asterisk and links to an input via htmlFor.
- [Line Chart](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/line-chart.md): Show a trend over ordered categories such as time. Server-rendered SVG on the chart palette.
- [Link](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/link.md): Styled anchor link with variant and external support.
- [Logo](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/logo.md): The Nexub mark and wordmark, with an optional product name.
- [Media Card](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/media-card.md): An image card with a glass caption over a soft scrim. With `href`, the whole card is one link.
- [Menubar](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/menubar.md): A horizontal bar of menus, like a desktop app’s File / Edit / View, built on Radix.
- [Message Bubble](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/message-bubble.md): One message in a conversation. User messages sit in a bubble at the end; assistant replies run full width. MessageActions adds copy, feedback and regenerate.
- [Money Input](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/money-input.md): An amount field: locale-aware parsing as you type, grouped on blur, the currency symbol leading.
- [Collapse](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/motion-collapse.md): Expands and collapses content along the block axis.
- [Fade](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/motion-fade.md): Animates opacity between 0 and 1 based on the `in` prop.
- [Float](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/motion-float.md): Gently bobs its content (floating cards over a hero visual), in marketing mode. Server component; still under reduced motion.
- [Marquee](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/motion-marquee.md): A row that scrolls sideways forever (logo strips, tool lists), in marketing mode. Pauses on hover and while focus is inside, stands still under reduced motion; the repeated copy is hidden from assistive tech and can’t be focused. Server component.
- [Reveal](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/motion-reveal.md): Fades its content up as it scrolls into view, in marketing mode. CSS scroll-driven where supported, an IntersectionObserver elsewhere; content on screen at load, and every visitor without JS or with reduced motion, just sees it.
- [Scale](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/motion-scale.md): Scales content in/out from its center.
- [Slide](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/motion-slide.md): Slides content in from a direction based on the `in` prop.
- [Multi Select](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/multi-select.md): Pick several options as chips, with search, "+N more" and an optional create option.
- [Navigation Menu](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/navigation-menu.md): Site navigation links with flyout panels, built on Radix.
- [Navigation Rail](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/navigation-rail.md): Navigation for medium-width windows: icons over labels, with an active pill behind the icon.
- [Number Input](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/number-input.md): A numeric input with increment and decrement controls, supporting min/max clamping and step.
- [Number Ticker](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/number-ticker.md): A number whose digits roll to new values on the spatial spring. The first render never animates.
- [OTP Input](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/otp-input.md): One box per digit for verification codes, with paste and one-time-code autofill.
- [Page Header](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/page-header.md): The top of a page: title, description, breadcrumb and actions.
- [Pagination](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/pagination.md): Page navigation control with prev/next and page number buttons.
- [Password Input](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/password-input.md): A password field with a built-in toggle to reveal or hide the entered value.
- [Plan Tracker](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/plan-tracker.md): An agent plan: ordered steps with done, active, pending or failed status.
- [Popover](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/popover.md): Floating content panel anchored to a trigger element.
- [Progress](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/progress.md): Horizontal progress bar with optional tone and animation.
- [Prompt Input](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/prompt-input.md): The composer for a chat: an auto-growing text field with Send, which turns into Stop while a reply streams.
- [Radio Card](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/radio-card.md): A radio group where each option is a whole card: title, description and optional icon, one choice.
- [Radio Group](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/radio-group.md): Group of mutually exclusive radio inputs.
- [Rating](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/rating.md): Star rating input, supports controlled and read-only modes.
- [Resizable Panels](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/resizable-panels.md): Panels with draggable separators, for list–detail and editor layouts.
- [Saved Views](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/saved-views.md): A menu to switch, save, update and delete saved filter views. Your app stores them.
- [Scroll Area](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/scroll-area.md): Scrollable container with custom styled scrollbars.
- [Scroll Progress](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/scroll-progress.md): A thin bar along the top that fills as the page scrolls. CSS only.
- [Search Input](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/search-input.md): A text input pre-wired with a search icon and a clear button for filtering content.
- [Section](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/section.md): A full-width page band with vertical padding and a background tone; put a `Container` inside.
- [Segmented Control](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/segmented-control.md): Tab-style control for mutually exclusive selections.
- [Select](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/select.md): Accessible dropdown select built on Radix UI. Supports groups and search.
- [Separator](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/separator.md): A horizontal or vertical visual divider.
- [Shared Element](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/shared-element.md): Morphs the same element between two states or pages inside a view transition.
- [Sheet](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/sheet.md): Alias for Drawer — slide-in sheet panel.
- [Sidebar](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/sidebar.md): Vertical app navigation: a header, grouped items with icons, and a pinned footer. Collapses to icons.
- [Skeleton](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/skeleton.md): Placeholder loading animation that mimics content layout.
- [Slider](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/slider.md): Range slider built on Radix UI Slider.
- [Sortable](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/sortable.md): A list people reorder by dragging or with Alt+Arrow keys on a handle.
- [Sparkline](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/sparkline.md): A tiny trend line with no axes, for stat cards and table cells.
- [Spinner](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/spinner.md): Animated loading indicator. Inherits color from context.
- [Split Button](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/split-button.md): A primary action with related secondary actions behind a chevron, as one connected control.
- [Stack](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/stack.md): Vertical stack layout with configurable gap.
- [Stepper](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/stepper.md): Progress through a multi-step flow, with clickable steps that follow the order you allow.
- [Streaming Text](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/streaming-text.md): Assistant text as it arrives: new chunks fade in, text already shown stays still, and a caret marks the end.
- [Switch](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/switch.md): Toggle control for binary on/off settings. Built on Radix UI Switch.
- [Table](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/table.md): Semantic HTML table with styled variants.
- [Tabs](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/tabs.md): Layered content panels switched by tab triggers. Built on Radix UI Tabs.
- [Text Gradient](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/text-gradient.md): Renders text with a brand gradient fill.
- [Text](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/text.md): Paragraph text component with size, tone, and weight variants.
- [Textarea](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/textarea.md): A multi-line text input with configurable resize behaviour, size, and validation states.
- [Thinking Indicator](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/thinking-indicator.md): Shows the assistant is working before the first token arrives: a morphing shape and a shimmering label.
- [Time Picker](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/time-picker.md): A time field on the native time input: 12 or 24 hours from the reader’s locale, and the platform picker on phones.
- [Toast](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/toast.md): Imperative toast notifications using the toast object. Render <Toaster /> once in your layout.
- [Toggle Group](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/toggle-group.md): Group of toggle buttons where one or many can be active.
- [Toggle](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/toggle.md): Pressable toggle button built on Radix UI Toggle.
- [Tool Call](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/tool-call.md): One tool call: its name and status, expandable to input and output.
- [Toolbar](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/toolbar.md): A row of buttons and toggles with one tab stop and arrow-key movement, built on Radix.
- [Tooltip](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/tooltip.md): Floating label that appears on hover. Built on Radix UI Tooltip.
- [Top Nav](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/top-nav.md): A sticky app header: logo, main navigation links and trailing actions.
- [Tree View](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/tree-view.md): A keyboard-friendly hierarchy (ARIA tree) with lazy children and tri-state checkboxes.
- [Visually Hidden](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/visually-hidden.md): Content for screen readers only: hidden on screen but still read out (Radix).

## Patterns

- [ActivityFeed](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/activity-feed.md): Chronological list of activity events with avatar, description, and timestamp.
- [AuthCard](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/auth-card.md): Authentication layout pattern. Wraps sign-in, sign-up, and reset flows in a centered card.
- [Bento Grid](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/bento-grid.md): A grid of card tiles in mixed sizes. Responds to its own width: 1 column, 2 at 480px, 4 at 768px.
- [Conversation](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/conversation.md): Chat layout: a scrolling message list that follows new content, with a sticky composer underneath.
- [Error Summary](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/error-summary.md): Lists a form’s errors after a failed submit, with a link to each field. useFormErrors wires the fields to their messages.
- [FilterBar](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/filter-bar.md): Search + filter toolbar pattern for data-heavy list or table views.
- [InfoList](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/info-list.md): Key–value list for displaying structured metadata or details.
- [List Detail](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/list-detail.md): The list-detail layout: side by side at 720px+ of its own width (a container query), one pane at a time below.
- [NotificationCenter](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/notification-center.md): A bell with an unread count that opens the notification list.
- [NotificationItem](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/notification-item.md): Single notification row for notification panels or dropdowns.
- [PlanCard](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/plan-card.md): Pricing plan card with feature checklist, badge, and CTA button.
- [SettingsSection](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/settings-section.md): Grouped settings panel with title, description, and action area.
- [StatCard](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/stat-card.md): Metric display card showing a KPI value, label, optional delta, and icon.
- [UserCard](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/user-card.md): User profile card displaying avatar, name, role, and optional actions.

## Marketing (@nexub/marketing, under data-mode="marketing")

- [Marketing mode](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/foundations/marketing-mode): guidelines, tokens and what changes
- [Next.js and server components](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/getting-started/nextjs): per-component imports, next/font, Tailwind 4
- [CTABand](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/cta-band.md): The closing call to action on a primary band: the hero gradient in marketing mode. Server component.
- [FAQ](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/faq.md): Questions and answers in an Accordion, one open at a time. Client component.
- [FeatureSplit](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/feature-split.md): Text and a check list beside a visual; `reverse` swaps the sides on wide screens. Server component.
- [Hero](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/hero.md): The page hero: ambient backdrop, eyebrow, display headline (the page's one h1), lead, actions and a visual. Server component.
- [HowItWorks](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/how-it-works.md): Numbered steps in an ordered list. Server component.
- [LogoStrip](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/logo-strip.md): A row of customer logos under the hero, scrolling sideways (paused on hover and focus) or wrapped. Server component.
- [MarketingFooter](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/marketing-footer.md): The site footer: a tools strip, the logo, link columns and the legal line. Server component.
- [MarketingNav](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/marketing-nav.md): The site header: logo, links with mega-menus, a country switcher and actions. Below `lg` the links move into a side sheet.
- [PricingTable](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/pricing-table.md): Plans side by side with a monthly / yearly switch, built on PlanCard and SegmentedControl. Client component.
- [ProductGrid](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/product-grid.md): Product cards in a grid; each card is one link with the product's accent. Server component.
- [SectionHeader](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/section-header.md): Eyebrow, headline and lead that open a section. Server component.
- [StatBand](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/stat-band.md): A band of headline numbers that count up as they scroll into view. StatBandItem is named apart from the StatCard pattern. Server component.
- [TestimonialGrid](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/testimonial-grid.md): Customer quotes in product-coloured cards, with an optional star rating. Server component.

## React Native

- [React Native](https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/getting-started/react-native): @nexub/react-native components and @nexub/react-native/patterns screens for Expo and bare React Native apps (native chrome, Nexub content)
